verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for an online registered-agent service, which runs a website and customer accounts, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows no opt-out capability: the only first-party probe hit a Cloudflare challenge on robots.txt, and the community item only remarks on the company's SEO.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
